title: Monthly spending
incompleteBankTotals: Some bank accounts have an unavailable balance or currency.
balanceHelp: Balances retain their reported signs and currencies. Credit card balances can represent liabilities.
accountLimit: Showing the first 200 accounts for this connection.
historyError: Balance history could not be loaded.
noHistory: No balance observations are available for this account.
investmentHelp: Each row shows the last reported position. Check its reference date before treating a value as current.
investmentLimit: Showing the first 200 positions for this connection.
saveError: The category could not be saved.
reviewError: The review decision could not be saved.
noReviews: No debits to review this month.
reviewHelp: Debits without enough evidence wait here, from every month. Once you include or exclude one, it leaves this list; reviewed debits stay below, where they can be reset.
reviewLimit: Showing up to 100 debits, with unreviewed debits first.
selectForSpending: Select a connection to view its spending.
noExpenses: No expenses are available. Load the synthetic demo or replay a connection.
matchingExpenses: Choose a category and where it applies: this merchant, every card purchase with the same MCC, or every expense in the same bank category.
suggestionsReady: Review the suggestions below before applying them.
noSuggestions: The model had no suggestion for these expenses.
suggestionsUnavailable: Local suggestions are unavailable. Check that the Ollama model is installed.
reportedInvestmentTotals: Reported investment net balances by currency
incompleteInvestmentTotals: Some positions have no reported net balance or currency.
monthlyComparisonHelp: Account debits and card purchases over the last 12 months, excluding transfers between accounts and card bill payments. Select a month to open it.
investmentComparisonHelp: Contributions minus withdrawals over the last 12 months, including Mercado Pago savings boxes and fixed income. Bars below the line mean more was withdrawn than invested. Income is shown separately.
categoriesHelp: Rename, add, move or archive categories and subcategories. Totals and rules follow the change immediately. Archiving hides a category and its subcategories, and its expenses return to automatic classification.
archiveCategoryConfirm: Archive {name}? Its expenses return to automatic classification.
categorySaveError: The category change could not be saved.
scopeProvider: Every expense in the bank category
manualExpensesHelp: Add expenses the bank does not report, such as rent paid from a savings box. A recurring entry repeats every month from its start until its end month (or until now). With a CNPJ, months that already have a reported payment to that CNPJ skip the entry, so a bill never counts twice.
manualError: The entry could not be saved or loaded.
savingsBoxOutflow: Left a savings box without a reported transaction
investedEvolutionHelp: Estimated invested money at the end of each month: today's reported balances (positions and savings boxes), minus the contributions and plus the withdrawals made after that month. Yield and market changes of past months are not known, so earlier months show the money put in rather than its value at the time.
